themes.name: Trae CN
themes.author: lmliheng
themes.description: Trae's own client palette: a #1a1b1d base with #222427 panels, the #32f08c brand green and the design blue #80c1ff. Both modes taken from Trae's client tokens, not its marketing page.
themes.descriptionZh: Trae 客户端的配色：#1a1b1d 底、#222427 面板、品牌绿 #32f08c、设计蓝 #80c1ff。浅色与深色都取自它的客户端令牌，不是官网首页。

themes.name: Clay Glow
themes.author: lmliheng
themes.description: Warm paper canvas with a terracotta accent: a warm editorial light side, and a warm near-black dark side.
themes.descriptionZh: 暖纸底配陶土强调：浅色是暖调纸面，深色是暖近黑配铜橙强调。

themes.name: VS Code Modern
themes.author: lmliheng
themes.description: VS Code's own two-tone shell — #181818 panels around a #1f1f1f editor — with its #0078d4 blue, 2px corners and 13px UI type. Colours taken from microsoft/vscode's default themes.
themes.descriptionZh: 照 VS Code 自己的样子：#181818 的面板包着 #1f1f1f 的编辑区，蓝色 #0078d4，2px 直角，13px 界面字。配色取自 microsoft/vscode 的默认主题文件。

themes.name: Kimi
themes.author: lmliheng
themes.description: Kimi's warm white ground with black primary buttons, 8–16px corners and a system font stack. Light and dark both read from the live site.
themes.descriptionZh: Kimi 的暖白底配黑主按钮，8–16px 圆角，系统字体栈。浅色与深色都按线上站点实测取值。
